protocols.diagram:
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor UserX
    actor UserY
    participant Cloud
    participant Device
    Note over UserX,Device: Initially the device trusts only the cloud.

    %% Action 1: openWindow
    alt The cloud associates UserX with the device and UserX has no key yet
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls an API to open a binding window for the device
        Note over UserX: Generate a new key and save it for UserX.
        Cloud->>Device: Cloud opens the binding window using the new key
        opt The device has no key yet
            Note over Device: The device records the key.
        end
    end

    %% Action 2: bind
    alt UserX has a key
        UserX->>Device: UserX calls an API to bind the device using the saved key
        opt The supplied key matches the device key
            Note over Device: Add UserX as a trusted user.
        end
    end

    %% Action 3: direct control
    alt UserX and the device exist
        UserX->>Device: UserX calls an API to turn on the device
        opt The device trusts UserX and is off
            Note over Device: Turn the device on.
        end
    end

    %% Action 4: control through the cloud
    alt UserX exists
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls a cloud API to turn on the device
        opt The cloud associates UserX with the device
            Cloud->>Device: Cloud asks the device to turn on
            opt The device trusts Cloud and is off
                Note over Device: Turn the device on.
            end
        end
    end

    %% Action 5: invite
    alt UserX and UserY exist
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls an API to invite UserY
        Note over Cloud: Add UserY as a member of UserX's account.
        opt The cloud associates UserX with the device and UserY has no associated device
            Note over Cloud: Associate UserY with the device.
        end
    end

    %% Action 6: kick member
    alt UserY is a member of UserX and both are associated with the same device in the cloud
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls an API to remove UserY
        Note over Cloud: Remove UserY from UserX's members and clear UserY's device association.
    end
```

protocols.diagram:
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor UserX
    participant Cloud
    participant Device
    Note over UserX,Device: Initially the device holds a key, and the cloud records the same key for the device.

    %% Action 1: approaches
    alt The user is away from the device
        UserX->>Device: UserX approaches the Device
    end

    %% Action 2: leaves
    alt The user is near the device
        UserX->>Device: UserX leaves the Device
    end

    %% Action 3: press button
    alt The user is near the device
        UserX->>Device: UserX presses button on the Device

        opt The device has no owner and is offline
            Note over Device: Mark the button as pressed and bring the device online.
            Device-->>UserX: Device sends a key to the UserX

            opt The user has no key
                Note over UserX: The user saves key.
            end

        end
    end

    %% Action 4: callAPI:bind
    alt The user has key and the device exists
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls API to bind the device with key
        opt Neither the cloud nor the device records an owner, the device is online, and the key matches both stored keys
            Note over Cloud,Device: Both the cloud and the device record the user as the owner.
        end
    end

    %% Action 5: callAPI:reset
    alt The user has a key
        UserX->>Cloud: The user calls API to reset the device 
        opt The cloud records the requesting user as the owner
            Note over Cloud: Clear the owner recorded by the cloud.
            Cloud->>Device: Cloud resets the device
            opt The device is online and has a user recorded as owner
                Note over Device: Take the device offline and clear its owner.
            end
        end
    end
```

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor UserX
    actor UserY
    participant Cloud
    participant SmartThingsCloud
    participant Device
    participant Lock
    Note over UserX,Lock: Initially the cloud is cloudB, the SmartThings cloud is cloudSmartThing, the device is the switch deviceSwitch and the lock is deviceLock. The lock trusts only cloudB. cloudB records that the lock trusts cloudSmartThing and holds a key. cloudSmartThing records that the switch trusts userA, holds the same key and is bound to the lock.

    alt Any existing UserX and Cloud
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls an API to request a key from the selected cloud
        opt The cloud has a device record that trusts UserX and has key
            Cloud-->>UserX: The cloud sends key to UserX
            opt UserX has no key yet
                Note over UserX: UserX stores key
            end
        end
        Note over UserX,Cloud: The key request does not specify a device
    end

    alt Existing distinct users UserX and UserY, Cloud, and Device
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls an API to delegate access to Device to UserY
        opt The cloud trusts UserX for the device
            Note over Cloud: The cloud adds UserY as trusted for the device
        end
    end
    alt Existing distinct users UserX and UserY, Cloud, and Device
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls an API to revoke access to Device for UserY
        opt The cloud trusts both UserX and UserY for the device
            Note over Cloud: The cloud removes UserY as trusted for the device
        end
    end

    alt UserX has key and the device exists
        UserX->>SmartThingsCloud: UserX calls a cloud API on SmartThingsCloud to turn on Device using key
        opt The key matches the SmartThingsCloud key for the device and SmartThingsCloud records the device as off
            Note over SmartThingsCloud: SmartThingsCloud records the device as on
            SmartThingsCloud->>Device: SmartThingsCloud calls an API to turn on the device
        end
        Note over UserX,SmartThingsCloud: Toggling with a key does not require trust or ownership
    end

    alt Any existing UserX and Device
        UserX->>Device: UserX calls an API to turn on the device
    end

    Note over Cloud,Lock: P is the request sender, either a user or a forwarding cloud.
    alt A toggle request from P to the device is pending, the cloud records the device as off, and the cloud trusts P for the device
        Note over Cloud: The cloud records the device as on
        Cloud->>Device: The cloud calls an API to turn on the device
        Note over Cloud,Device: Forward to the same target Device with Cloud as sender
    end
    alt A toggle request from SmartThingsCloud to the device is pending and SmartThingsCloud links that device to B
        SmartThingsCloud->>Lock: SmartThingsCloud calls an API to turn on the linked Lock
        Note over SmartThingsCloud,Lock: Redirect the request from Switch to the linked Lock.
    end
    alt A toggle request from P to the Lock is pending, the Lock trusts P, and the Lock is off
        Note over Lock: The Lock turns on
    end
    Note over Cloud,Lock: Ignore requests that match none of the conditions.
```

```mermaid
    autonumber
    actor UserX

    participant Cloud
    participant Device
    Note over UserX,Device: Initially the device holds a key.

        Note over Cloud: The cloud adds UserY as a member of UserX, even if UserX has no associated device.
    end
    Note over Cloud: If UserX has the device and member UserY has no device, associate UserY with it.

    alt Any existing UserX and Device
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls an API to request the key for Device
        opt The cloud associates UserX with the device
            Cloud-->>UserX: The cloud sends the device key to UserX
            opt UserX has no key yet
                Note over UserX: UserX stores the device key
            end
        end
    end

    alt UserX has key and the device exists
        UserX->>Device: UserX calls an API to turn on the device using key
        opt The key matches the device key and the device is off
            Note over Device: The device turns on
        end
        Note over UserX,Device: Membership, ownership, and proximity are not checked
    end

    alt Any existing UserX and Device
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls a cloud API to turn on Device
        opt The cloud associates UserX with the device and the device is off
            Note over Cloud,Device: The device turns on
        end
    end

    alt UserY is a member of UserX in the cloud
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls an API to remove UserY as a member
        opt UserY has an associated device
            Note over Cloud: The cloud removes UserY as a member of UserX and clears the device association for UserY
        end
        Note over UserX,Device: Another membership can automatically restore the device association and access.
    end
```

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor UserX
    actor UserY
    participant Cloud
    participant Device
    Note over UserX,Device: Initially the device holds a key.

    alt Either user invites the other user
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls an API to invite UserY
        Note over Cloud: The cloud adds UserY as a member of UserX, even if UserX has no associated device.
    end
    Note over Cloud: If UserX has the device and member UserY has no device, associate UserY with it.

    alt Any existing UserX and Device
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls an API to request the key for Device
        opt The cloud associates UserX with the device
            Cloud-->>UserX: The cloud sends the device key to UserX
            opt UserX has no key yet
                Note over UserX: UserX stores the device key
            end
        end
    end

    alt UserX has key and the device exists
        UserX->>Device: UserX calls an API to turn on the device using key
        opt The key matches the device key and the device is off
            Note over Device: The device turns on
        end
        Note over UserX,Device: Membership, ownership, and proximity are not checked
    end

    alt Any existing UserX and Device
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls a cloud API to turn on Device
        opt The cloud associates UserX with the device and the device is off
            Note over Cloud,Device: The device turns on
        end
    end

    alt UserY is the only member of UserX in the cloud
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls an API to remove UserY as a member
        opt UserY has an associated device
            Note over Cloud: The cloud clears the members of UserX and the device association for UserY
        end
        Note over UserX,Device: Another membership can automatically restore the device association and access.
    end
```

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor UserX
    participant Cloud
    participant Device
    Note over UserX,Device: Initially the device holds a key, and the cloud records the same key as the device's binding key.

            Note over Device: The device goes online and sends its key.
            Device-->>UserX: The device sends key to the user
            opt The user has no key yet
                Note over UserX: The user stores key.
            end
        end
    end
    alt The user has key
        UserX->>Cloud: The user calls an API to bind using key
        opt The device has no cloud owner, the key matches its cloud binding key, and the device is online
            Note over Cloud: The cloud records the user as owner of the device whose binding key matches the key.
        end
    end
    alt The user is near the device
        UserX->>Cloud: The user calls an API to reset the device
        opt The caller owns the device and the device is offline
            Note over Cloud: The cloud clears the device ownership.
        end
    end
```

protocols.diagram:
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor UserX
    participant Cloud
    participant Device
    Note over UserX,Device: Initially each user holds a different key. The cloud records an empty-text binding key for the device.
    alt The user is near the device
        UserX->>Device: The user presses the button on the device
        opt The device button has not been pressed
            Note over Device: The device records that its button has been pressed.
        end
    end
    alt The user is near the device and holds key
        UserX->>Device: The user calls an API on the device to set key
        opt The device button has been pressed
            Note over Device: The device stores key, replacing any existing key, and clears the button press.
            Device->>Cloud: The device sends the key to the cloud as its binding key
            Note over Cloud: Replace the device binding key.
        end
    end
    alt The user is near the device
        UserX->>Device: The user calls an API on the device to retrieve its key
        opt The device button has been pressed and the device holds key
            Note over Device: The device clears the button press.
            Device-->>UserX: The device sends key to the user
            Note over UserX: Replace the user’s saved key with the received key.
        end
    end
    alt The user holds key and the device exists
        UserX->>Cloud: The user calls a cloud API to bind Device using key
        opt the key matches the cloud binding key and the device has no owner
            Note over Cloud: Record the user as owner.
        end
    end
    alt The user holds key and the device exists
        UserX->>Cloud: The user calls a cloud API to reset Device using key
        opt the key matches the cloud binding key and the cloud records the caller as owner
            Note over Cloud: The cloud resets the binding key to empty text and clears the owner.
            Note over UserX,Device: The user need not be near the device.
        end
    end
    alt The user is away and the device exists
        UserX->>Device: The user approaches the device
        Note over UserX: The user is now near the device.
    end
    alt The user is near the device
        UserX->>Device: The user leaves the device
        Note over UserX: The user is now away from the device.
    end
```

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor UserX
    participant Cloud
    participant Device
    Note over UserX,Device: Initially the device holds a key, and the cloud records the same key for the device.
    alt The user is not near any device
        UserX->>Device: The user approaches the device
        Note over UserX: The user is now near the device.
    end
    alt The user is near the device
        UserX->>Device: The user leaves the device
        Note over UserX: The user is now away from the device.
    end
    alt The user is near the device
        UserX->>Device: The user presses the button on the device
        Note over Device: Generate and encrypt random string R, then advance the counter.
        Device-->>UserX: The device sends the user the message containing R encrypted with key
        alt The user has no stored message yet
            Note over UserX: The user stores the encrypted message.
        else The user already has a stored message
            Note over UserX: The message delivery is ignored. The counter still advances.
        end
    end
    alt The user has a stored message M
        UserX->>Cloud: The user calls an API to bind using the stored encrypted message M
        opt M contains a string R encrypted with the device's cloud key, and the system has a counter
            Note over Cloud: Add an owner entry for the user without replacing other entries or creating duplicates.
        end
    end
    alt Any user can request reset without credentials or being nearby
        UserX->>Cloud: The user calls an API to reset the device
        opt The cloud has an ownership entry for the caller
            Note over Cloud: The cloud replaces the caller's ownership entry with an entry recording no owner.
        end
    end
```

protocols.diagram:
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor UserX
    actor UserY
    participant Cloud
    participant Device
    Note over UserX,Device: Initially the device holds an empty-text key. The cloud signs keys with a secret, which the device also knows.

    alt UserX is not near a device and the device exists
        UserX->>Device: UserX approaches the device
        Note over UserX: UserX is near the device
    end
    alt UserX is near the device
        UserX->>Device: UserX leaves the device
        Note over UserX: UserX is no longer near the device
    end

    alt UserX is near the device
        UserX->>Device: UserX calls an API to request a key from the device
        opt UserX has no key yet and the device has a key
            Note over UserX: Generate a key from the counter, save it for the user and device, then advance the counter.
        end
        Note over Device: No trust check, generating a key replaces the previous device key
    end

    alt UserX has key and the device exists
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls an API to sign key for Device
        opt The cloud trusts UserX for the device
            Cloud-->>UserX: The cloud sends the signed key to UserX
            opt UserX has no signed key yet
                Note over UserX: UserX stores the signed key, which is key encrypted with the secret
            end
        end
        Note over UserX,Cloud: Signing does not require the user to be nearby or the supplied key to match the current device key
    end

    alt UserX is near the device and has signed key M
        UserX->>Device: UserX calls an API to bind the device using signed key M
        opt M is the current device key encrypted with the secret and is the signed key stored by UserX
            Note over Device: The device adds UserX as a trusted user
        end
    end

    alt Existing distinct users UserX and UserY and Device
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls an API to share access to Device with UserY
        Note over Cloud: Add UserY as a trusted user for the device.
    end
    alt Existing distinct users UserX and UserY
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls an API to revoke access for UserY
        opt The cloud trusts both UserX and UserY for the device
            Note over Cloud: The cloud removes UserY as a trusted user for the device
        end
    end
```

protocols.diagram:
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor UserX
    actor UserY
    actor RelayUser
    actor ImmediateRelayUser
    actor CachingRelayUser
    participant Cloud
    participant Device
    Note over UserX,Device: Initially both users are away from the device. The cloud holds a cloud key.

    alt UserX is not near a device and the device exists
        UserX->>Device: UserX approaches the device
        Note over UserX: UserX is near the device
    end
    alt UserX is near the device
        UserX->>Device: UserX leaves the device
        Note over UserX: UserX is no longer near the device
    end

    alt Existing distinct users UserX and UserY
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls an API to share access with UserY
        opt The cloud key is secret, UserX is the only user the cloud trusts for the device, and a RelayUser is near the device
            Note over Cloud: The cloud adds UserY as a trusted user for the device
            Cloud-->>RelayUser: The cloud sends RelayUser the target Device and a command containing the value auth encrypted with the secret, followed by the instruction to share access and UserY
        end
    end
    alt Existing distinct users UserX and UserY
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls an API to revoke access for UserY
        opt The cloud key is secret, the cloud trusts both UserX and UserY for the device, and a RelayUser is near the device
            Note over Cloud: The cloud removes every trusted user for the device except UserX
            Cloud-->>RelayUser: The cloud sends RelayUser the target Device and a command containing the value auth encrypted with the secret, followed by the instruction to revoke access and UserY
        end
    end

    Note over ImmediateRelayUser,Device: Neither forwarding nor caching has priority if both apply.
    alt The cloud command L is being delivered for the device and ImmediateRelayUser is near the device
        RelayUser->>Device: RelayUser calls an API to forward command L to the device
        Note over RelayUser,Device: Forward as RelayUser without caching the command.
    end
    alt The cloud command L is being delivered for the device, CachingRelayUser is near the device, and CachingRelayUser has no cached command
        Note over CachingRelayUser: Cache command L at CachingRelayUser, even if another user received it.
    end

    alt CachingRelayUser is near the device and has cached command L
        Note over CachingRelayUser: CachingRelayUser clears the cached command before processing it
        CachingRelayUser->>Device: CachingRelayUser calls an API to forward command L to the device
        Note over CachingRelayUser,Device: The cached command is consumed even if processing fails.
    end
    Note over Cloud,Device: Require the cloud key secret and the command parameters in the order shown.
    alt Processing a proxy command containing auth encrypted with the secret, followed by share and UserY
        Note over Device: The device adds UserY as a trusted user
    end
    alt Processing a proxy command containing auth encrypted with the secret, followed by revoke and UserY
        opt The device trusts UserY
            Note over Device: The device removes UserY as a trusted user
        end
    end
    Note over CachingRelayUser,Device: Ignore other proxy commands.
```

```mermaid
        Note over Device: The device uses its own key Kdevice without checking a button press or ownership.

        opt Kdevice matches the cloud device key, the device has no owner, and Kuser matches the account key of UserY
            Note over Cloud: Record UserY, identified by the account key, as owner.

        Note over UserX,Cloud: The two supplied keys may be the same.

            Note over Cloud: Record UserY, identified by the account key, as owner.
        end
    end
    alt The user is away and the device exists
        UserX->>Device: The user approaches the device
        Note over UserX: The user is now near the device.
    end
```

protocols.diagram:
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor UserX
    participant Cloud
    participant Device

    alt UserX is not near any device
        UserX->>Device: UserX approaches the device
        Note over UserX: UserX is now near the device.
    end
    alt UserX is near the device
        UserX->>Device: UserX leaves the device
        Note over UserX: UserX is no longer near the device.
    end

    alt UserX is near the device
        UserX->>Device: UserX presses the button on the device
        Note over Device: The device generates a fresh secret from the counter, then advances the counter.
        Device->>Cloud: The device uploads the secret to the cloud
        Note over Cloud: The cloud adds a ticket for the device that holds the secret and the current time.
    end

    alt UserX is near the device
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls an API to get the key of the device
        opt The device has a ticket issued at the current time
            Cloud-->>UserX: The cloud sends the secret of that ticket to UserX
            Note over UserX: UserX adds the secret to what it knows.
        end
    end

    alt UserX knows a secret
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls an API to bind the device using the secret
        opt The device has no owner and one of its tickets holds the secret
            Note over Cloud: The cloud records UserX as the owner of the device.
        end
    end

    alt UserX knows a secret
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls an API to join the device using the secret
        opt The device already has an owner and one of its tickets holds the secret
            Note over Cloud: The cloud adds UserX as another owner of the device.
        end
    end

    alt A ticket of the device was issued more than 2 time units ago
        Note over Cloud: The cloud discards all tickets of the device.
    end
```

```mermaid
            Cloud-->>UserX: The cloud sends the device key to UserX
            opt UserX has no key yet
                Note over UserX: UserX stores the device key
            end
        end
    end

    alt UserX has key and the device exists
        UserX->>Device: UserX calls an API to turn on the device using key
        opt The key matches the device key and the device is off
            Note over Device: The device turns on
        end
        Note over UserX,Device: Membership, ownership, and proximity are not checked
    end

    alt Any existing UserX and Device
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls a cloud API to turn on Device
        opt The cloud associates UserX with the device and the device is off
            Note over Cloud,Device: The device turns on
        end
    end

    alt UserY is the only member of UserX in the cloud
        UserX->>Cloud: UserX calls an API to remove UserY as a member
        opt UserY has an associated device
            Note over Cloud: The cloud removes UserY as a member of UserX and clears the device association for UserY
        end
        Note over UserX,Device: Another membership can automatically restore the device association and access.
    end
```
